messages:
hana (sales): Zenith is reporting a spike of 429s during a bulk embed run this morning. They say it started at ~08:45 PT and is affecting their demo. Can we triage?

raj (solutions): Are they on hosted/trial? Any Request-Id or sample curl?

hana (sales): Hosted trial. Customer sent this example and the response: \n\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ZEN123" \\n  -d '{"model":"embed-2048","input":[...],"batch_size":120}'\n\nResponse:\nHTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nRetry-After: 2\nX-RateLimit-Limit: 150\nX-RateLimit-Remaining: 0\nRequest-Id: r-d9f7a4\n
viv (eng-oncall): That Request-Id looks like a route-level burst exhaustion. Can ops paste the ingress trace?

hana (sales): Support log: [ingress] req=r-d9f7a4 route=/v1/embeddings key=sk-ZEN123 concurrency=9 tokens=7680 status=429 throttle=burst_window_exhausted:embeddings_v1

tyler (eng-sre): Root cause: multiple workers launched roughly simultaneously causing a burst window to exhaust. Trial keys have small burst multipliers. Because batch_size is large each call consumes many tokens, exacerbating the burst.

raj (solutions): Immediate guidance: add startup jitter, lower batch_size to 64-96, implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After. Also suggest per-worker keys to shard limits.

hana (sales): Can we do a short-term ops bump so their demo doesn't fail?

tyler (eng-sre): We can grant a 90-minute temporary burst increase for sk-ZEN123 if Sales requests it. Ops ticket required and we'll monitor for noisy neighbors.

ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-912 to request temporary burst increase for sk-ZEN123 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-912) :white_check_mark:

viv (eng-oncall): Action items:
- @tyler open/track ops ticket and watch infra metrics
- @raj send Zenith the quick-fix checklist (batch_size, jitter, backoff, per-key)
- @hana confirm demo window and whether they accept a credits offset for the bump

hana (sales): I'll relay the checklist now and ask if they want the temporary bump. Thanks team!
